name: Performance Weapon Mastery
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Performance Weapon Mastery (Combat)
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 112
You wield all your weapons with the flair of a performer.

Benefit: You treat all weapons you are proficient in as if they had the performance weapon quality (page 144).
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128
As long as you have at least 1 stamina point in your stamina pool, you treat all weapons—not just the ones you are proficient with—as if they had the performanceUC weapon quality.
